title: `calc(NaN * 1px)` prints as `5.10424e38px`, so a NaN a browser censors to 0 becomes the largest length
impact: Only reachable by writing the NaN keyword (or 0*infinity style expressions) in calc(), which real stylesheets don't do. 0 reactions, no project named, agent-style batch. Same class as #1397 (out-of-range font-weight calc), which the maintainer said he'd probably close.
code: src/values/calc.rs: Constant::Nan folding (no top-level censoring step)
summary: calc() folding turns `NaN * 1px` into a plain f32 NaN, and the serializer hands NaN to dtoa_short, which prints the garbage value 5.10424e38. Per css-values-4, NaN does not escape a top-level calculation and is censored to 0; Chromium computes margin-left 0px and matches `(min-width: calc(NaN * 1px))` at any width, while the output matches never. Also hits numbers (opacity: 5.10424e38 instead of 0), angles, NaN inside a kept calc (`calc(NaN * 1px + 1em)` -> `calc(5.10424e38px + 1em)`) and `calc(infinity * 0px)`. Properties wrapped in NonNegative already print 0 on master since #1329.
repro: 1405-repro.mjs. `.a { margin-left: calc(NaN * 1px) }` -> `.a{margin-left:5.10424e38px}`; `@media (min-width: calc(NaN * 1px))` -> `@media (width>=5.10424e38px)`; `opacity: calc(NaN)` -> `opacity:5.10424e38`. Controls: `calc(infinity * 1px)` -> 3.40282e38px (equivalent); `width: calc(NaN * 1px)` -> `width:0` on master (5.10424e38px in 1.31-1.33).
evidence: repro.mjs local + 1.31.1..1.33.0, and --range 1.20.0..1.33.0 (always wrong). probe.mjs Chromium 153: margin-left calc(NaN*1px) => 0px, calc(NaN*1px + 1em) => 0px, opacity calc(NaN) => 0, matchMedia('(min-width: calc(NaN * 1px))').matches => true vs '(min-width: 5.10424e38px)' => false. Spec css-values-4 §IEEE: '[=NaN=] does not escape a [=top-level calculation=]; it's censored into a zero value'. Source: cssparser 0.37 write_numeric calls dtoa_short::write without a NaN check.

fix.approach: Handle non-finite values where Lightning CSS serializes numbers (CSSNumber::to_css, serialize_dimension): NaN prints as `NaN` (dimension: `NaN * 1unit`) when dest.in_calc, otherwise as 0 (censored). Better long-term: a single 'top-level calc result' step that censors NaN and clamps to the property's range, which would also cover #1397. Low priority; fine to close instead if the maintainer treats it like #1397.

notVerified: Firefox/WebKit results claimed by the reporter not checked (Chromium only). Did not check every property using CSSNumber/Angle/Time serialization.
